text: This final chapter completes Spread Clusters: 6 Voicing Types across 6 Cycles in C Harmonic Minor. The voice-leading grids continue: Drop 2 & 3 on Cycle 7 (3 → 4th, three c.t. voices; functional 3 → 7, 7 → 1, 2 → 3, 1 → 2). 4-way close on Cycle 5 shows contrary-motion voice-leading (7 → 2nd, 3 → 3rd, 2 → 3rd, 1 → 2nd intervallic; 7 → 2, 3 → 1, 2 → 7, 1 → 3 functional). Drop 3 Cycle 5 specifies all four voices moving by 3rds and 2nds with functional 3 → 1, 2 → 7, 7 → 2, 1 → 3. Cycle 3 4-way close encodes the tightest chromatic voice-leading density in the chapter's system.
